reauth_confirm.title: Renew AlorAir-Lite login
reauth_confirm.description: Connect your existing AlorAir-Lite account. The vendor API uses unencrypted HTTP: your email, session token, commands and readings are exposed in transit. Your password is RSA-wrapped for login but this does not secure the connection. Home Assistant stores the account password in its configuration; protect your configuration and backups. This unofficial integration supports devices owned by your account. Nothing is re-paired.

reconfigure.title: Change the connection
reconfigure.description: Your device and dehumidifier entity identities are retained. Local mode supports power, humidity targets, Auto/Continuous mode and temperature display units, and reports inlet/outlet humidity, temperature, specific humidity and draining state from the device’s own status reports; faults, purge and locator still require cloud mode. Command reliability is still being tested; use local mode only for supervised testing. Prepare routing and DNS separately before switching.

local.title: Experimental local connection
local.description: Local mode supports power, Auto/Continuous mode, humidity targets (25–80% in 5% steps) and temperature display units. Route the already-provisioned appliance’s connection to this listener and prepare DNS separately; setup does not configure your router or Wi-Fi. Both connections keep the same entity names and IDs. Local mode reports inlet/outlet humidity, temperature, specific humidity and draining state from the device’s own status reports; faults, purge and locator still require cloud mode. Command reliability is still being tested; use local mode only for supervised testing. Local mode does not contact the vendor cloud. Enable experimental power-on separately in Configure.

reconfigure_local.title: Use the experimental local connection
reconfigure_local.description: Local mode supports power, Auto/Continuous mode, humidity targets (25–80% in 5% steps) and temperature display units. Route the already-provisioned appliance’s connection to this listener and prepare DNS separately; setup does not configure your router or Wi-Fi. Both connections keep the same entity names and IDs. Local mode reports inlet/outlet humidity, temperature, specific humidity and draining state from the device’s own status reports; faults, purge and locator still require cloud mode. Command reliability is still being tested; use local mode only for supervised testing. Local mode does not contact the vendor cloud. Enable experimental power-on separately in Configure. This removes stored cloud credentials and retains the device and all entity identities. Restore cloud routing separately before switching back.

local.title: Experimental local power
local.description: Experimental local starts use the selected humidity target or continuous mode. Enable only after preparing local routing and DNS. Local mode reports inlet/outlet humidity, temperature, specific humidity and draining state from the device’s own status reports; faults, purge and locator still require cloud mode.
